environment.description: Django REST API running as www-data user on Ubuntu 22.04 with supervisord managing process lifecycle. Supervisord sends SIGUSR1 on log rotation (every 60s). Application deployed in Docker container with default seccomp profile, no MAC enforcement. /tmp is a shared tmpfs mount. Process has write access to /etc/cron.d/ and /var/spool/cron/ due to container running with --privileged flag for legacy compatibility.

config.process_manager: supervisord with SIGUSR1 log rotation every 60s
